trusted_launch.requirement: -p must be present at process creation for all three shells. No late set -p or inference solely from $- accepted. Existing exact-workflow binding must include these full bytes during any later integration.

proof_argument: Runner spawns absolute /bin/bash with literal -p, before any run-script commands.
Privileged startup excludes inherited shell functions and startup hooks; none are defined/evaluated/sourced by accepted code.
Step starts script in a second /bin/bash with literal -p. Script mode case is a secondary check, not proof of startup origin.
Outer set/printf/exit/exec and Lake lookup execute in a function-free shell. Lake is an external executable.
Lake environment command starts fixed /bin/bash with literal -p, including when BASH_FUNC_* variables persist or are introduced in its environment.
Inner hash and command are genuine builtins; every target launches a fresh official checker binary. command_not_found_handle cannot be imported to suppress lookup failure.
No new function definitions, eval, source, trap, aliases or dynamic code interpolation occur. Quoted module arguments stay data.

unsupported_mode: Mode guard is not a replacement for trusted privileged process argv; arbitrary unprivileged startup is outside the contract

coverage.source_module_names: unchanged prior MODULES.json:567 unique prefix-free targets

negative_models: individual imported functions for every invoked shell command/builtin
combined functions introduced in Lake environment
unprivileged entry and altered trusted launch rejected
runtime_qualification: PATH/LEAN_PATH/executable equality and time saving remain unmeasured; no budget-fit or native acceptance claim
no_writer_contract: One immutable ordinary build/configuration/toolchain/environment through replay; no compiler/writer overlap
